name: Apps SDK
summary: OpenAI's Apps SDK lets developers put their own tools and interfaces inside ChatGPT. An app is an MCP server whose tools can return UI templates that ChatGPT renders in a sandboxed iframe; the open MCP Apps standard is the base layer, with ChatGPT-specific extensions under window.openai. OpenAI's developer docs now present this work as ChatGPT plugins, published through the ChatGPT Directory after review.
facts: MCP server plus MCP Apps UI resources
Sandboxed iframe; window.openai for ChatGPT extensions
ChatGPT fully compatible with the spec (2026-02-22)
Submission and review for the ChatGPT Directory
goodFor: Reaching ChatGPT users with an interactive tool
Reusing one MCP server across ChatGPT and other MCP Apps hosts
watchOut: Terminology and docs have shifted from apps to plugins
